Dialogs.Dialog: ▲高嶺＊＊▲. ...What's up, you look really sleepy.
Mm... I was reading a novel, and it got light outside...
You pulled an all-nighter！ Are you okay？
What do I do, I'm so sleepy... What do I do. Ugh.
I forgot something. I have to hurry back for childcare practice.
Childcare practice... Ah, the one where you play with babies？
Yes. When I go, "It's big sis Manaka▼," they smile so cutely♪
Ah, I have to go. Bye？
(If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ did that to me, I'd be happy too, kid or not.)
Apparently there's a pop quiz in the next English class.
Well... do you like them, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes, you can see your current level and weak points, right？ I like overcoming them one by one. Solving a problem I couldn't before makes me happy.
Haa, such nice weather it makes me want to skip...
No, no！ I just said it makes me WANT to！
Hmm, and here I thought I'd join you... Just kidding, that's a no, okay？
Do you like the cafeteria food？
I was wondering if I should study it.
The cafeteria？ I don't think you need to go that far, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I see... Then it's fine. If you say so.
Huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you doing here？
...I was curious how the potatoes they're growing at school are doing.
What!? ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I know you love them, but that's going too far！
...Then I won't share any when they're harvested. Bye？
(Hah... Making me carry these heavy materials alone... The teacher's working me too hard.)
Haha, true. Then, a little, please.
Don't you think we should have more calligraphy classes？
Calligraphy... Well, lots of guys would be happy. It's easy.
Geez. It's not time for slacking off, you know？
If anything it makes me feel more focused. But it's hard, after all...
Apparently there's a surprise evacuation drill today.
We evacuate as a group. If everyone ran, there'd be panic. So: don't panic, don't make noise, and hurry.
(Don't panic, don't make noise, hurry... that's hard.)
Hey, do you know any way to stop your stomach from growling？
...You're the only one who thinks so. Hey, think of something？ Please.
(True, I don't want other guys hearing it... but is there even a way？)
I got my uniform a little wet...
Ah, that's why. It does stand out.
It's a little embarrassing. I think it'll dry soon, but I'll change right away.
Nothing！ I hope it dries fast！
Biking to school sounds kind of nice.
That'd be nice... on the same bike as you...
The same bike... You mean riding double to school？
Eh... no！ Riding double is against school rules, and it's against the law too...
Hey, do you keep a spare umbrella at school？
Me？ No, that's a hassle in its own way.
Why ask all of a sudden？
No, if you don't have one, that's fine. Don't worry about it？
(Is there something bad about having one？)
Some class must have cooking practice. That smell is unfair...
Hey, if I brought curry for lunch and ate it in class, would that bother people？
Curry？ The smell... If you ate it cold, it'd probably be fine？
...Curry that tastes good cold, huh. Hmm...
(I could learn a thing or two from ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s spirit of adventure...)
Um, if you have your Japanese textbook, could you lend it to me？ I forgot mine...
You forgot something, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ That's rare. Sure.
There are probably doodles on a bunch of the portraits, so forgive me.
...Geez, you shouldn't do that. As punishment, I'll grade your doodles.
Yeah. Super. I might doze off.
...Mm, now you're wide awake. See you later.
(On my cheek... works like a charm...)
That bakery truck driving around outside earlier was something.
If they keep calling out "Fresh-baked melon bread," it makes you curious.
Won't you go buy some, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
What if I buy some, and you eat it？
Well... last period was self-study. And I had questions I wanted to ask.
I guess I'll have to wait until next class.
The cafeteria is taking recipe submissions, apparently.
Huh. Why not send one in, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
...Really？ Letting other people have my cooking？
Huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you doing？
▲主人公＊▲. I showed an exchange student to the gym. She just arrived and didn't know where it was.
In English. I can do a little everyday conversation.
It really is just a little, so don't look at me with such sparkling eyes？ Okay？
I have cooking practice after this...
...Ah, you don't like their eyes, right.
Yes... But I'll do my best！
(I hate that all I can do is cheer her on！)
Ah, sorry. We're doing table tennis in gym...
You're not bad at it, right？
But everyone's expecting so much... I can't beat people from the table tennis club.
(I get why they'd expect a lot, though...)
(Well, I'd better head back to class...)
Whoa... Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Are you okay？
Sorry, I'm in a bit of a hurry... Sorry, I'll properly... later, bye.
(That's unusual... rushing like that, the bathroom？)
...Huh？ So the piano wasn't you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Piano？ Oh, right. Too bad, wrong guess.
Right, I thought so！ You're way better, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Such a smooth talker. Now, let's go back to class？
No. ...If you want to listen, listen to mine？ Come on, let's go.
(This kind of jealousy isn't bad... maybe？)
Huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. ...What are you looking at？
Well... there are blackboard erasers on the roof of the bike shed. Two of them.
Maybe someone dropped them while clapping them out？
Maybe？ But there's a cleaner, so would anyone clap them by hand？
But it looks kind of fun. Maybe I'll try it when I'm on duty♪
Huh. ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what are you doing？
▲主人公＊▲. I was going to return a book to the library... but maybe I'll do it later.
Because I ran into you. ...Just kidding▼
▲高嶺＊＊▲, that book you borrowed... was it a romance novel？
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Got any snacks or something？ I'm starving.
I don't. They're against school rules.
And... I ate too much at lunch... so no snacks for me. Bye.
(She's worried about overeating？ She doesn't need to be.)
What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Communicating with UFOs out here？
No. I came to borrow one. Um...
One like "How to Make Your Boyfriend Even Crazier About You▼"？
...Geez. ...Hey, are there really books like that？
I'll press the pressure point that boosts concentration, okay？ Mm... mm.
Who knows. If it works, tell me？ Bye.
(If I say it worked, will she do it again？)
▲主人公＊▲. Got a minute？ Want to go to the school store together？
Sure, but... are you buying something heavy？
No. ...I just wanted to go with you. Is that bad？
Not bad at all, let's go！
(This feels like a little school date. Nice.)
But I was just thinking of stopping.
If my focus is broken, continuing won't give good results. Help me take a break？
Geez. ...Next time don't just watch, call out to me before I yawn, okay？
▲主人公＊▲. How long have you been there？
I see. ...Then you didn't hear, right？
Why's the bell ringing now... Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, it's still break, right？
Guess this happens... Ah！ Don't tell me――
...Just kidding. You like turning things into stories like that, don't you？
Do you know the last song on the lunch broadcast？ I missed the title...
The last one, so that visual-kei-ish song？ Huh, you're into that kind of thing too？
The melody was pretty, so I thought it might be fun to arrange it for piano.
I see. Hmm, sorry. I don't remember either.
No, it's fine. I remember most of it, so I'll try writing it out as sheet music. Thank you.
...Um, well？ A note passed around from a friend. I was going to write back.
Ah, the kind girls pass around in class... You don't have to hide it.
It's a secret between girls, so no more questions. Okay？
(I'm curious what it says... but ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wouldn't write during class, after all.)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hm？ Do you have something in your mouth？
Mm... someone gave me a candy. I usually say no, but...
I see. Technically it's forbidden, huh.
They said it's a throat drop, so it's okay... What do you think？
(I can't help it, she makes me want to tease her！)
Yo. Hey, they're replacing the vending machine at the school store. What do you think they'll put in？
This time, I'd like a super-rich milk tea with 5 times the amount of tea leaves▼
Then I'll say an oden drink！
That's basically broth, right... I hope they get it♪
Do they ever replace the school's cleaning supplies, I wonder？
Don't they when they get old？
That's not it... If there were better ones than what we have, it'd be more efficient.
(Nobody else takes school cleaning that seriously...)
If we were together, it'd be fun...
Eh... um... If you say so, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Thank you. But you'd get in trouble. I'll just take the thought▼
(Well. I'd better head back to class...)
In Japanese class next, I'm reading aloud. So I'm a little nervous.
Ahh... I get that. Even you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
It's always at times like this that I stumble over words. Even though I usually don't.
I thought I'd go to the nurse's office.
No. I wanted to talk with Ms. Miyauchi. She's like a big sister, so she's easy to talk to.
I see... Well, as long as you're not sick, good.
Yes, thank you. Well, I'm off？
Are bag inspections really that bad？
Not bad exactly, more like... icky.
Apparently there's one in my class after this, so they'll probably do yours too.
This wind is crazy... Can we even practice in this？
It'd feel nice to stand upwind. You make more mistakes, though, so be careful.
Right. I get it. It fires you up！
Fires you up？ Hehe, let's get fired up♪
Huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Weren't the girls running？
I finished early, so I'm taking a little break.
Huh, how much did you run？
Practicing swings now？ Can I join you？
(That's not a break... How tough are you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Today we're doing some unusual training, apparently.
Huh... don't tell me you're it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Bingo. Run for real, okay？ Because I'll catch you for real♪
Still not enough practice？ You're tough.
No, that's not it. What's not enough is...
Ramen after practice, dude, let's go...
...I'm sorry！ Um, it was a penalty game... I can't do it, Miyoshi-san！
Even when practicing swings, not focusing is dangerous, you know？
......You're right. Hehe！ Ah. That's not the point...
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s focus seems to be slipping too. Better be careful...)
The light in the club room is out, and I was asked to go get a replacement.
(She remembered it by seeing my face... why？)
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Don't we have a lot of spectators today？
Middle schoolers on a school tour, apparently.
Then maybe they'll be our juniors someday... All right！
Isn't it too late to start looking sharp now？
It's not too late. I think！
Mm. Let's show them lots of good stuff？
(Welcome to the Towano High tennis club！)
Huh. Somehow we ended up last.
It's less that we ended up last, and more that they let us...
"Take your time," she said... Geez, Miyoshi-san...
Isn't Mr. Suzuki really fired up today？
Yes. Apparently his wife is here.
He probably wants to show off how hard he works in front of the person he loves？
▲高嶺＊＊▲... Crap！ Mr. Suzuki is glaring at us, let's go！
If you stood upwind, you could hit a magic shot.
Lots of people hate strength training, don't they？
You become aware of muscles you don't normally use, so I kind of like it.
Our club sometimes tries to act like a sports club...
We ARE a sports club！ When we're done, I'll give you a massage, so let's do our best？
Guess I came a little too early...
I saw you... so I came.
Then let's do the court maintenance？
Ah, don't rub it！ Let me see？
Today, I kind of want to skip practice and go home.
If I said "no reason"... would that surprise you？
But, well, sometimes you feel like that, right？ Yeah.
...Thank you. Mm, but I'll do my best！
Rain, huh. How long will it keep up, I wonder？
Hmm. It'll stop by noon, I think.
Then I vote it keeps raining until evening.
Rain, huh. I wonder if it'll get heavier.
If it's going to rain, I wish it'd pour so school gets canceled.
Geez. Then we couldn't go to school together.
Yeah, morning. Looks like it's raining.
Yes. Rainy days make hair care hard.
Ah, right, girls have it tough. I wish the rain would announce itself the day before.
Hehe. Isn't that the weather forecast？
Yeah, blue skies are the best.
Such nice weather. Today's going to be fun.
It's a little cloudy. I hope it doesn't rain...
The sky looks like it's about to cry. Will it be okay...
Yeah, I hope it doesn't rain.
It's cloudy now, but it's fine. It'll clear up, I'm sure. Right？
Well, it's nice in its own way.
All rain men, raise your hands？
I'm definitely looking forward to it more than you.
Hey. It's coming up soon, right？
Don't tell me you forgot. Our date！
Of course I remember. Can't wait.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. It's fine. You didn't need to run like that.
Sorry, can you go on ahead？ I think I forgot my pencil case...
I'll lend you mine. If you go back now, you'll barely make it.
Really？ Thank you... Studying with your pens might feel kind of new.
Haha, then lend me yours sometime, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I'm fine. I just got absorbed in a book and stayed up late... I'm a little sleepy.
Ah, that happens to me too. You miss your chance to fall asleep...
I stepped on something... What is it...
Let's see... Hm？ It's a work glove.
Huh？ Why is that here... Phew, that surprised me.
I made a bento. Will you eat it？
Of course！ Where should we eat？
Um, I made a bento... I hope it's to your taste.
Yes！ Let's go eat right away！
Today it's Manaka's special love bento.
I didn't make a bento today...
Then want to try the cafeteria？ We haven't gone together yet.
Um, about lunch today... would the cafeteria be okay？
The cafeteria？ Sure. Come to think of it, we've never gone together.
I thought I'd like to try it.
Hey, want to try the cafeteria for lunch？
The cafeteria, huh. We haven't been together yet. Let's do it.
Want to try the cafeteria for lunch？
Thanks for the meal. That was good.
Ahh, I'm so full I'm getting... sleepy.
Geez, don't fall asleep in class, okay？
From now on, only eat until you're 80% full.
Thanks for the meal. That was great...
That good？ Then I have to remember it... wait, let me take notes.
Huh？ You'll make it for me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Sorry if it doesn't come out good. Don't expect too much.
That was good. Thanks for the meal！
Ah, I can't lose either. I have to make even tastier bentos.
No way you'd lose. Your bentos are the best for me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I'd hate to get wet. Glad I brought it.
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you have an umbrella？
...Then I'll say I don't have one.
...Ah, that's what you mean！ Then let's walk home together.
Okay. Do you have an umbrella？
All set？ Hehe, then let's go home.
What a pain. Guess I'll run home...
Hey, don't tell me you don't have an umbrella？
Yeah. Well, if I run home...
No, if you get wet you'll catch a cold. I have an umbrella, so let's go home together？
Ugh, it's really coming down... oh well, I'll run.
Um, here, some sweets. I made them in home ec.
I think they came out good, but...
Eat as much as you like▼
How is it？ I don't think it tastes strange.
I hope they taste good？ I'm a little worried.
(Well, I'd call it a safe taste.)
How is it？ Your honest opinion？
I tried adding a secret ingredient. How is it？
(Ugh... this secret ingredient isn't secret at all... Isn't it a failure？)
Does it suit your taste... How is it？
(Ugh... this is... before even talking about taste...)
I hope you like it. How is it？
Huh... ▲高嶺＊＊▲!? Did you come to wake me up？
Yes... You were half asleep until just now.
Ah, sorry. Did I wake you？
▲高嶺＊＊▲... You came to wake me up. ...Were you watching me？
Um... your sleeping face was so cute.
You were watching the whole time？
Are you embarrassed？ It was embarrassing for me to watch too, so we're even.
How long are you going to sleep？ You'll be late, you know？
(I can't believe ▲高嶺＊＊▲ yanked my covers off...)
(Mm... ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ She came to wake me...)
(Sorry, but I'll sleep a little longer...)
Geez, what to do... Maybe I'll pour water on you？
(I feel like I heard something scary... a dream？)
Wow, you wake up so easily.
I was watching your sleeping face and dozed off. Sorry.
Don't tell me, you slept next to me？
Hmm... Is that the smell of miso soup...？
Huh... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you made me breakfast？
Yes. I got up early and came to make it.
Good morning. Let's eat breakfast together？
You came to make it, thanks. Isn't cooking first thing in the morning hard？
It's fine, sit. You have to eat properly in the morning to get your energy.
(Ah, this feels like a newlywed life... It's a dreamy morning！)
Delicious！ I'm so lucky to have a girlfriend who can cook！
I made it in a bit of a hurry, so it might not be perfect.
Sorry. The flavor's a little bland, isn't it.
Less salt is the key to health！ I hear this is just right.
Good morning. I came to make breakfast.
Hehe. If it makes you that happy, call me anytime.
How does it taste... I made it in a bit of a hurry.
Sorry, it got a little burnt... You can leave it, okay？
I could never leave food you made, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...Hey, have you decided what you're having for dinner？ If not, I thought I might come make it.
Yeah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Let's go home together.
Yes... Um, have you thought about dinner？ If you like, I thought I might come cook.
Ah, wait. Um, have you decided what to eat for dinner？ Shall I come cook for you？
Really？ Then let's buy ingredients？ A detour... is okay, right？
This store has a great selection.
I like this store because it's easy to shop at.
Shopping at the supermarket together... Hehe♪
Now... hey, what do you want to eat？
Today, I want to eat ▲メニュー▲.
Hehe, that's one of my specialties, you know？
Um, it might take me a little while... is that okay？
Come on in, make yourself at home.
Thanks for having me. The bags were heavy, right？ I'll start cooking right away.
It might be a little messy, but come on in.
Not sure I cleaned up properly... Well, come in.
I don't mind that. Sorry for intruding.
Come to think of it, it's the first time you've come to cook after school.
That's true. When I think about it... I'm a little nervous.
Thank you. I like your room, it's relaxing.
Then I'll get started right away.
Um... then I'll start making dinner.
Now, time to show off my skills？ Hehe♪
Thanks for today. I was really happy.
You're welcome. I'm glad you're happy.
No, I'll be fine from here. See you.
Ahh, I'm totally satisfied today. Thank you.
Sorry for inviting myself over so suddenly...？
You're always welcome. I'll walk you home.
Ah... it's fine, you don't need to. I can get home myself, so relax... See you.
If you say that, I might come every day, you know？ ...Just kidding.
You're totally welcome！ Anyway, it's late, so I'll walk you home.
You don't need to worry about me. I'll come again, okay？ Bye-bye.
I'll walk you home after all.
You know, I keep a diary. It's pretty fun.
Huh, what do you write about？
Aw, why？ Anyone would ask, the way this was going.
Normally, nobody tells you what's in it.
